Every gaze was fixed on the masked figure, curiosity mixing with anticipation as they waited to witness the inevitable outcome.
Yet among all those watching, there were only two whose hearts were gripped by genuine worry.
Lucia and Isabella.
They stood amidst the crowd, their eyes locked onto Max, their expressions filled with disbelief that had yet to fully settle.
They had never imagined he would go this far, never thought he would throw himself directly into such a deadly confrontation without hesitation.
"This is bad... this is really bad," Lucia muttered under her breath, panic rising uncontrollably within her as she clenched her fists.
This situation had spiraled far beyond anything she could have prepared for.
Beside her, Isabella remained silent.
Unlike Lucia, she held herself together, her expression calm on the surface, yet her eyes betrayed the storm beneath.
She understood the weight of what Max had just done.
By attacking those elves, he had stepped into a situation where retreat would no longer be simple.
He had placed himself directly in the path of danger.
And there was no easy way out anymore.
"Die, you insolent brat!"
Just at that moment a roar tore through the air as the elves finally moved.
The elderly elf’s expression twisted with fury, his hand rising as a blazing golden light gathered within his palm before he struck forward without hesitation.
The attack descended with terrifying speed, so fast that even Max’s Dimensional Sovereign Body could barely register it in time.
And then it hit him.
Bang!
A violent force slammed into him, sending his body hurtling through the air like a broken projectile.
He crashed into the distance with overwhelming momentum, the ground trembling beneath the impact as debris scattered outward.
The surrounding crowd reacted instantly, retreating in all directions, clearing a path as no one dared to remain in the trajectory of such a battle.
"No... no, no..." Lucia’s voice trembled as she saw Max being thrown away like that, panic surging through her as she instinctively moved forward, ready to rush to him.
But before she could take another step, Isabella caught her wrist and held her firmly in place.
"If we interfere now, we will doom the entire Black Dragon Clan," Isabella said, her voice low yet resolute, her eyes never leaving the battlefield.
Lucia froze.
The weight of those words struck her harder than the scene itself.
Her mind raced, and in that moment, Max’s earlier words echoed within her. ’Pretend like you don’t know me.’
Her lips tightened as she bit down hard, forcing herself to stop, even though every instinct within her screamed to run to him.
In the distance, the elderly elf let out a cold sneer as he watched the aftermath.
"He should be dead," he said dismissively, his tone filled with absolute certainty.
"Go.
Bring me his body.
I will search his soul myself and find out which force dared to send someone to ambush our Young Master."
The two elves beside him nodded and began moving toward where Max had fallen, their expressions calm, as if this was already over.
But then—
They stopped.
Because Max... stood up slowly.
As if the previous strike had not been enough to break him.
"What... he’s still alive?" The elderly elf’s eyes narrowed in disbelief, genuine shock flashing across his face.
He had not held back.
That attack had been more than sufficient to kill someone at the Rebirth Realm.
And yet, here he was.
Standing, Max lifted his head.
"I want... all of you to die."
His voice was low, but the hatred within it was suffocating, so dense that it seemed to distort the air itself.
His eyes burned with a cold, relentless fury, and as that hatred surged through him, something deep within his being stirred in response.
Something dark.
Something forbidden.
Something that had been silent... until now.
From the depths of his existence, the infernal demon power began to awaken once again.
At first, it was only a faint whisper of temptation.
It slithered through his mind like a shadow, wrapping itself around his thoughts, feeding on the storm of emotions raging within him.
Hatred.
Pain.
Loss.
The perfect fuel.
"Why hold back?"
The voice did not come from outside.
It echoed from within, deep and ancient, carrying a tone that felt both alluring and terrifying.
"They took everything from you... and yet you still stand here, restraining yourself."
A subtle heat began to rise within Max’s body, not like ordinary energy, but something far more sinister, something that carried a suffocating presence.
"Look at them... standing before you as if they own your fate."
The whisper grew clearer.
Stronger.
"They stole your bloodline.
They destroyed your life.
They stole your parents form you.
And now... they dare to stand above you?"
The infernal power pulsed violently, responding to the hatred in his heart, amplifying it, twisting it, turning it into something darker.
"Accept me."
The words came like a promise.
"I will give you power beyond anything you have ever known."
The air around Max began to tremble faintly, as if reacting to the awakening force within him.
"I will give you the strength to crush them."
His heartbeat slowed, yet each beat felt heavier, echoing with a growing intensity.
"I will give you the power to make them suffer... to make them beg... to erase them completely."
The whispers no longer felt distant.
They were right there.
Inside him.
"I will help you kill them."
The infernal demon power surged again, no longer dormant, no longer suppressed.
It clawed its way upward, drawn by his fury, eager to take hold, eager to break free.
"Take it."
"Take the power you deserve."
"Take your revenge."

chapters.title: Chapter 1549: Fury Burns The Heart - 3
paragraphs: A strange silence fell over Max as the whisper coiled tighter around his thoughts, no longer something distant, no longer something he could ignore. It was right there, pressing against his will, offering him everything he desired in that moment.
Power.
Revenge.
Destruction.
For a brief instant, his gaze flickered.
Then—
He smiled.

It was not a normal smile. It was twisted, filled with a chilling madness that made the air around him grow cold despite the violent energy rising within his body. It was the kind of smile that came when restraint finally shattered, when something deep within a person chose to stop holding back.
"Give me..." Max murmured softly, his voice low and dangerous, as if he had already made his decision long before this moment arrived.
The hesitation vanished.
"Infernal Demon Transformation... Full release."
The words echoed like a forbidden decree.
And in the next instant, a beam of red light released from his body tore through the air into the clouds.

Just at that happened a violent surge of power erupted from within his body, spreading outward in a terrifying wave as if something ancient had been unsealed. His aura twisted, no longer pure, no longer stable, but warped into something dark and oppressive that made the very space around him distort.
His skin began to shift first.

A deep crimson color spread rapidly from his chest, racing across his body until every inch of him was stained in an intense, blood-like red. It was not just his skin. His entire being transformed. From his hair to the very tips of his fingers, even down to his toes, everything turned into that same terrifying shade, as if he had been reborn from within a sea of blood.
His hair darkened and then ignited into a crimson glow, strands lifting as demonic energy surged through him. His eyes which were already red began to glow in deep shades of demonic red.
Then came the pressure.
It exploded outward.

The ground beneath him cracked as a suffocating demonic aura descended upon the surroundings, so heavy that even those watching from afar felt their breathing hitch. It was no longer the aura of a human.
It was something far more sinister.
Something that did not belong.
A sharp tearing sound echoed through the air.

From his back, two massive wings burst forth, formed from pure demonic energy. They spread wide behind him, dark and ominous, their surface rippling like living shadows, exuding a presence that felt both ancient and destructive.
At the same time, his forehead began to change.

The skin split slightly as two curved horns pushed outward, growing steadily until they stood proudly atop his head. They were dark, sharp, and menacing, carrying an aura that radiated absolute dominance.
Max’s transformation was complete.

He stood there in the sky, no longer resembling the human who had arrived moments ago. His entire body radiated a terrifying red glow, while his demonic wings stretched behind him, casting a shadow that seemed to swallow the light itself.
The horns atop his head gave him the appearance of a true infernal being, one that had stepped out from the depths of hell.
And his eyes—
They burned.
Not with light.
But with endless hatred.

Just as the infernal power surged higher, threatening to consume the last remnants of his sanity, Max forced himself to hold on. The darkness clawed at his thoughts, whispering endlessly, trying to drag him deeper into its abyss, but at the very edge of losing himself, he gathered what little clarity remained.
Then he whispered to himself.
"Keeper’s Dominion."

The moment the skill activated, a sharp shift occurred within him. It was as if an invisible force descended upon his mind, sweeping away the suffocating evil chaos that had begun to take root. The whispers vanished. The overwhelming hatred, though still present, was no longer wild and uncontrollable. It became contained.
The infernal power still roared within him, but it no longer ruled him.
It obeyed to his will.

Max inhaled slowly, his crimson eyes regaining a chilling clarity as his thoughts aligned once more. The demonic aura surrounding him did not weaken. If anything, it felt even more terrifying now that it was under his control.
’This power... it’s even stronger than before,’ he thought, a faint flicker of realization passing through his mind as he felt the sheer magnitude of strength coursing through his transformed body.
And then—
He moved.
His figure vanished.
There was no warning. No visible motion. One moment he stood in the air like a demonic sovereign, and the next, he was gone, leaving behind only a faint distortion where he had been.
The elves barely had time to react.
Before one of the guards could even shift his gaze, Max appeared directly in front of him.
Too fast.
Far too fast.
The elf’s eyes widened in shock, his instincts screaming danger, but his body could not keep up. There was no time to defend. No time to evade.
Max’s fist drove forward.
It did not stop.

With terrifying precision and overwhelming force, his hand pierced straight through the elf’s chest, tearing through flesh, bone, and organs as if they were nothing. The impact was brutal, absolute, leaving no room for resistance.
For a single moment, everything froze.
Max’s arm emerged from the elf’s back, drenched in blood.
Silence followed.
A suffocating, heavy silence.
The elf guard, a peak Law Manifestation Realm expert, stood there with his eyes still wide, his expression locked in disbelief as his life slipped away in an instant he could not even comprehend.
Then his body went limp.
And collapsed.
The scene... shattered everyone’s understanding.
All around the hexagonal barrier, every single person stood frozen, their expressions turning from curiosity to complete shock.
"What...?"
Someone’s voice trembled, unable to even form a complete sentence.
A peak Law Manifestation Realm expert...killed instantly by a single strike by someone who had just moments ago been dismissed as a reckless fool at the peak of the Rebirth Realm.
Their gazes shifted back to Max.
No—
To that figure.
That being.
The crimson body. The demonic wings spreading behind him. The dark horns curving from his head. The suffocating aura that felt like it came from the depths of hell itself.
He no longer looked human.
He looked like a devil that had descended into their world.
The shock deepened.
"What... what is that thing?"
"That’s not a human..."
"How did he just kill a Law Manifestation Realm expert like that?"
Disbelief turned into fear as the reality of what they had just witnessed began to settle in.
Even the major forces who had remained indifferent until now felt their expressions change.
The young woman from the Sword God Palace narrowed her eyes, the calm in her gaze breaking for the first time as she stared at Max’s transformed figure.
"That transformation..." she whispered, her voice no longer as certain as before.

Not far away, the members of the Accession Hall had gone silent, the earlier mockery completely gone from their faces. The young man who had laughed moments ago now stood stiff, his eyes locked onto Max with a trace of unease he could not hide.

chapters.title: Chapter 1550: Fury Burns The Heart - 4
paragraphs: "How dare you... kill one of us?!"
The moment the elf guard fell, the atmosphere snapped.

The remaining elves no longer held back even a fraction of their killing intent, and at the center of it all stood the elderly elf, his expression completely twisted with fury as his gaze locked onto Max’s demonic form. The sight of that crimson body, those horns, those wings... it did not instill fear in him.
It ignited rage.
"You devil..." his voice trembled with suppressed killing intent, his aura surging violently as golden light erupted around him, "you will pay for this with your life!"
The moment his words fell, a radiant golden sword condensed within his grasp, its brilliance blinding as it hummed with terrifying power.
He did not hesitate and brought his sword down carrying the full weight of a peak Law Manifestation Realm expert.
Seeing this, Max did not move. Instead, he raised his left hand.
And took it head on.
Bang!
The collision exploded like thunder.

The moment the golden sword struck his arm, a violent shockwave burst outward, rippling through the air like a storm. The ground beneath Max’s feet could not withstand the force and shattered instantly, cracks spreading in all directions as the impact drove him slightly into the earth.
Yet—
He did not budge.
His arm held firm, his crimson skin resisting the blade as if it were made of indestructible metal. The golden sword trembled against him, unable to cut through.
The surrounding air distorted.
Even the hexagonal barrier in the distance flickered faintly, reacting to the violent surge of energy.
Max’s eyes burned brighter.
Then—
He moved.
His right hand clenched into a fist, muscles tightening as raw, demonic strength gathered within it before he drove it forward without restraint.
There was no technique to it, no concept.... It was just raw power.
The elder elf’s eyes narrowed as he reacted instantly, golden light surging once again as a radiant shield formed before him.
Bang!
The fist collided with the shield, and the impact detonated like an explosion.

A second shockwave erupted, stronger than the first, tearing through the surroundings as the air screamed under the pressure. Dust and debris were blasted away, and even those watching from afar felt the force crash into them like a physical blow.
The hexagonal barrier trembled again though not violently but enough to make those observing realize that this fight was beginning to cross a dangerous threshold.

The elder elf held his ground, the golden shield absorbing the blow, yet the force behind Max’s punch still pushed him back several steps, his feet dragging against the ground as his expression darkened.
But Max didn’t stop. He once again moved and disappeared.
Reappearing to the side of the elder elf, his wings flaring as he launched another strike, his fist cutting through the air with terrifying speed.
The elder elf responded just as quickly. Golden light surged around him as multiple constructs formed in an instant.
Swords, spears and Blades of pure radiance.
They shot toward Max like a storm.
However, Max refused to back down. He took these constructs head on.

Each construct shattered upon contact with his body, exploding into fragments of light as his raw strength crushed everything in his path. He broke through the barrage and closed the distance once more, his fist descending like a falling mountain.
The elder elf raised another construct and this time even a bigger shield was formed and then-
Another collision.
Another shockwave.

This time, the impact sent both of them sliding back, the ground splitting beneath their feet as the force spread outward in all directions. The surrounding space trembled continuously, and the hexagonal barrier flickered more visibly now, its surface rippling under the repeated pressure.

’My strength should be around the peak of the Law Manifestation Realm, yet even that is not enough to kill them,’ Max thought as his mind raced through the situation with growing urgency. The previous elf he had slain had fallen only because he had been caught off guard, but as the battle continued, the remaining elves had become increasingly vigilant, their caution sharpening with every exchange.
A surprise attack would no longer be easy.

At the same time, Max clearly understood that the elder elf confronting him was far too powerful. Even after unleashing the full might of his Infernal Demon Transformation, he had only managed to hold the opponent at a stalemate, unable to gain any decisive advantage.

Realizing this, his gaze slowly shifted toward the young master who carried his bloodline. A cold glint surfaced in his eyes as a single thought took root in his mind. If he could kill that young master and reclaim the bloodline, perhaps the burning rage within his heart would finally find some measure of relief.

"Don’t you dare lay a hand on our young master!" the elder elf shouted as he immediately sensed the change in Max’s intent, his expression turning grave as he moved to block Max’s path without hesitation.

"You can’t stop me," Max replied, his voice low and resolute, yet just as he was about to move, his Dimensional Sovereign Body suddenly erupted with a violent warning, and a chilling sense of death washed over him like a freezing tide. His instincts screamed at him, forcing his body to react before his thoughts could catch up, and he retreated ten steps in an instant with explosive speed.
Bang!

In the very next moment, a massive sword descended from the sky and obliterated everything in the space where he had been standing just a heartbeat earlier, reducing the ground to ruin with terrifying force.
’If that strike had landed on me, I would already be dead,’ Max realized, his expression turning grim as the weight of that narrow escape settled in his heart.
At that moment, a young woman from the Sword God Palace appeared in the sky above, accompanied by an old man whose presence felt calm yet overwhelmingly oppressive.
"Are you someone from the Devil Race?" the young woman asked, her gaze sharp and filled with suspicion.
Max did not answer her question and instead met her eyes with a steady look. "Are you planning to interfere in this matter?"
